description: Core 1.0 does not support chomping indicators `|-`/`|+` — each is an ordinary unquoted string. The freetext line following it is not on the closed strict-error list (§10.1 only lists an empty inline slot's freetext-without-`|` as `null`/throw), so strict mode behaves identically to non-strict: the inline value is kept, the freetext line is silently skipped.
notes: Same input as core.block-scalar.chomping-indicator-unsupported.non-strict, asserting strict/non-strict parity — same reasoning as core.block-scalar.folded-marker-unsupported.strict for `>`.
